title: Conserved molecular compatibility for MIZ1 function in cytokinin signaling in land plants
authors: Smoljan A; Das S; Vladimirstev D; Teplova A; Tkachenka M; Yang W; Lu M; Benková E; Friml J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究陆生植物MIZ1蛋白在细胞分裂素信号中的功能保守性，虽涉及蛋白结构、ER定位和蛋白-蛋白对接，但核心是进化生物学与植物发育功能，而非蛋白质结构计算建模方法创新，仅部分使用计算工具，故评5分。
abstract: Plant roots adjust their growth direction toward water through hydrotropism, a process that in Arabidopsis thaliana requires the endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-associated protein MIZU-KUSSEI1 (MIZ1). Nonetheless, MIZ1 orthologues occur throughout land plants, including lineages lacking true roots, raising questions about the ancestral function of this protein family. Here, we investigated the evolutionary conservation and functional diversification of MIZ1-like proteins across land plants. MIZ1 orthologues from evolutionarily distant land plants failed to restore hydrotropism or cytokinin sensitivity in the Arabidopsis miz1 mutant, despite conserved protein structure and ER localization. In the liverwort Marchantia polymorpha , loss of MpMIZ1a led to altered cytokinin sensitivity and cytokinin-mediated development in both the sporophyte and gametophyte. These phenotypes and gene expression analyses imply a conserved role of MIZ1 in cytokinin-related processes. Despite this functional similarity, protein– protein docking and bimolecular fluorescence complementation revealed species-specific interactions between MIZ1 proteins and their cognate cytokinin histidine kinase receptors in Arabidopsis and Marchantia. Together, our findings indicate that MIZ1 proteins represent ancient land plant regulators of cytokinin-dependent development whose molecular compatibility and developmental outputs have diverged during evolution. We propose that the role of MIZ1 in root hydrotropism represents a derived recruitment of this ancestral module into root-specific environmental response pathways.
abstract_zh: 植物根系通过向水性（hydrotropism）调整其生长方向朝向水源，这一过程在拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）中需要内质网（ER）相关蛋白MIZU-KUSSEI1（MIZ1）。然而，MIZ1直系同源物存在于所有陆生植物中，包括缺乏真正根系的谱系，这引发了关于该蛋白家族祖先功能的问题。在此，我们研究了MIZ1样蛋白在陆生植物中的进化保守性和功能分化。来自进化上 distant 的陆生植物的MIZ1直系同源物未能恢复拟南芥miz1突变体中的向水性或细胞分裂素敏感性，尽管蛋白结构和内质网定位保守。在苔类植物地钱（Marchantia polymorpha）中，MpMIZ1a的缺失导致孢子体和配子体中细胞分裂素敏感性和细胞分裂素介导的发育发生改变。这些表型和基因表达分析暗示MIZ1在细胞分裂素相关过程中具有保守作用。尽管存在这种功能相似性，蛋白-蛋白对接和双分子荧光互补实验揭示了拟南芥和地钱中MIZ1蛋白与其同源细胞分裂素组氨酸激酶受体之间的物种特异性相互作用。综合来看，我们的发现表明MIZ1蛋白是细胞分裂素依赖性发育的古老陆生植物调节因子，其分子兼容性和发育输出在进化过程中已发生分化。我们提出，MIZ1在根系向水性中的作用代表了这一祖先模块被衍生性地招募到根系特异性环境响应途径中。
